name: Glaucous-Col
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in magnetic pole anomalies. Travelers navigate by an ancient meteor crater and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Herds of six-limbed graziers shadow the meltwater margins, wary of anything that walks upright.
Established during the last boom, the smuggler cache was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
The quarantine perimeter has held for years, mostly out of mutual disinterest. Everyone checks the fence anyway.
